documents.text: Working field page Home / Research / Ageometrics Ageometrics Ageometrics: Geometric Sufficiency and Residue Analysis studies what a declared geometry preserves, what it erases, and what auxiliary channels restore target-relevant decision value. Narrative bridge. If a final form is a lossy residue of exploration, Ageometrics asks what the observer can still recover from it. Every assessment is relative to a declared observer, protocol, representation, and target . Similarity is not identity, and sufficiency for one target does not imply a unique history or a complete world model. Status Decision-theoretic working paper Version 0.5 Attribution Synaptient Claim boundary Minimal reproducible illustration, not broad empirical validation Current release posture. Ageometrics is published here as a decision-theoretic working paper with a minimal reproducible illustration, typed residue taxonomy, and an explicit benchmark roadmap. Cross-domain validation, sensitivity analysis, observer-envelope testing, and exhaustive prior-art review remain in progress. Claim boundary. Same-learner V-GSR holds the declared observer and much of the comparison protocol fixed, but it remains observer- and architecture-relative. Model-envelope views are robustness-oriented, not automatically conservative. Measurement frame Declared geometry vs residue vs restore Question Keeps Must not imply Sufficiency What decision value survives compression into the declared geometry? That the geometry is the whole world. Residue What target-relevant structure remains outside it? That residue is noise by default. Restore Which channels recover decision value? That recovery erases the earlier loss. Minimal reproducible illustration, not broad empirical validation. Comparators keep the claim honest. Core question Geometry is one of science's most powerful compressive languages. Coordinates, neighborhoods, symmetries, manifolds, graphs, and topologies can all preserve striking amounts of structure. That success also creates a methodological risk: a useful geometry does not by itself show that the representation preserves everything relevant to a declared task. Ageometrics asks that narrower question directly. How much target-relevant decision value survives compression into a declared geometry? How stable is that result across reasonable representations and observer choices? What typed residue remains outside the geometric account? The Geometric Sufficiency Ratio The Geometric Sufficiency Ratio compares prediction from a declared geometric representation with prediction from a declared fuller reference record. GSR = 0 : the geometry adds nothing beyond baseline. GSR = 1 : the geometry preserves all target-relevant decision value available from the fuller record. 0 < GSR < 1 : the geometry is useful for the declared target but incomplete. The framework also defines observer-relative V-GSR for restricted predictive families, temporal and interventional extensions, representation-stability envelopes, and a typed taxonomy of Non-Geometric Residue. Comparator discipline is part of the definition. A GSR estimate without a declared comparison protocol is not an Ageometrics result. Minimal reproducible illustration The current public illustration plants temporal information outside a declared terminal-geometric representation and then measures how much of the available log-loss improvement survives in geometry alone. Under the seeded same-learner protocol, the geometry-only channel recovers only about one fifth of the fuller-record improvement. This is a controlled minimal reproducible illustration. It is not a broad validation suite, not proof of cross-domain adequacy, and not a claim that the residue taxonomy is complete. Why it matters Many natural and computational systems develop through local action, finite perception, path dependence, and embodied history. Final form may preserve part of that history while erasing other parts. Ageometrics provides a protocol for measuring what survives and for testing candidate explanations of what was lost. This matters especially for history-bearing artificial systems. Full developmental records can be compared with embeddings, graphs, summaries, attractors, replay states, or memory topologies to test how much causal, provenance, contradiction, and continuity information survives each conversion. Blind growth, bifurcation, and nodes One important Fractalish claim is that many branching systems are effectively blind while they are forming. The active front does not consult a completed blueprint. It responds to local contact, finite-range fields, current obstruction, and whatever consequence has already been embodied in the growing structure. On that view, branches, bifurcations, nodes, and screened interior regions are not just shapes. They are partial records of encounter history: where growth could proceed, where it split, where it was diverted, and where earlier path choices changed later accessibility. Ageometrics does not assume that such structures preserve the whole history. It supplies a way to test which parts of that history remain recoverable and which parts have been compressed away. Connection to Fractalish Fractalish asks what history becomes visible in form. Ageometrics asks what history disappears when reality is reduced to form. One studies the evidentiary power of structure. The other measures its declared limit. Different systems can carry different priors, strengths, blind spots, and failure modes. That makes disagreement useful, not automatically correct. A minority objection may overturn broad agreement when it identifies a broken premise, missing control, conflicting artifact, or stronger native-domain explanation. No participant outranks evidence. Multi-model consensus is not a vote, peer review, replication, or scientific validation. Human routing remains load-bearing The current workflow often uses explicit files, copy/paste, prompts, locked source packets, and state-transfer artifacts. Consumer chat interfaces are not dependable automation APIs; heterogeneous orchestration can be expensive; browser automation is brittle and may violate intended access patterns. Humans therefore assemble the packet, route it, preserve independent outputs, protect private material, and authorize publication. This is neither fully automated inquiry nor an autonomous AI parliament. Human routing is transport and governance; it does not make a human opinion stronger than a receipt or a valid objection.

This is the place for working notes on the Fractalish series: discovery story, vocabulary formation, Morphological Memory Theory, MCVA and AMCVA, negative regimes, machine-native vision, and the recurring effort to make a strange but useful worldview readable without letting it turn into overclaim. documents.title: Evidence Library - Fractalish
documents.headings: Evidence Library
documents.text: Public Materials Evidence Library The Evidence Library is where examples stop being slogans and start becoming comparison objects. This library should gather public-safe examples, synthetic demos, manifest entries, descriptor notes, and cautious case studies across domains such as roads, fractures, erosion, roots, dendrites, and other morphology-bearing structures. If the atlas is the vocabulary layer, the Evidence Library is the example layer. It gives future users and contributors something concrete to inspect, criticize, and extend. Just as important, it should also preserve negative cases: ambiguous images, misleading shadows, low-resolution failures, overcompressed files, and structures that look suggestive but do not support reliable interpretation. That is where AMCVA and HOLD earn their keep. The public library is not meant to prove everything at once. It is meant to build a transparent record of where the framework seems useful, where it fails, and where better data or stronger baselines are still needed. For public release, this is also where the rights discipline has to remain strongest. If a file cannot be published safely, the library should still preserve the manifest trail without posting the underlying asset. Back to Fractalish

documents.text: Public Materials First Life Archive Before the framework became a stack of documents, it was also an image intuition. The First Life Archive collects the imagery, notes, and conceptual fragments around early branching, green-lightning forms, first visible contact, and the recurring idea that life writes itself into structure before it writes itself into language. This archive is less about proof than orientation. It helps explain why branching, emergence, tension, and fragile first contact keep showing up as the emotional seed of the project. For new readers, this archive gives emotional coherence to the rest of the stack. It shows that the project did not begin as a classifier or a descriptor list. It began with a repeated confrontation with forms that felt like they were trying to say something about process. Publicly, this archive should function as a carefully framed image-and-note collection, not as cosmology or grand explanation. It is a record of the origin imagery behind the thesis. Over time, this archive may connect the visual language of roots, scars, discharge paths, rivers, dendrites, and volcanic ash to the more formal language of MCVA, Natural Math, and Morphological Memory Theory. documents.title: Machine-Native Vision - Fractalish
documents.headings: Machine-Native Vision
documents.text: Public Materials Machine-Native Vision Machine-native vision asks what happens when sensing stops trying to imitate the human eye first. Here, the goal is not simply to turn sensor data into a picture for a person. The goal is to detect, preserve, and emit morphology-bearing signals directly: branch patterns, fracture topology, erosion fronts, vascular structures, spatial roughness, and other forms that may function as process evidence. This page belongs to the future-facing perception side of the stack. MCVA is about readout. Natural Math is about generation. Machine-native vision is about what kind of sensing substrate might feed those layers well. Infinitysight belongs here as a future perception layer. It is about perception, not proof. A machine-native system may become better at seeing morphology across sensors and scales, but that does not mean it automatically knows what the morphology means. For contributors, this is research rather than a shipping claim. It points toward sensing pipelines, robotics, inspection, multimodal morphology extraction, and machine-native tokenization while keeping unsolved components explicit. The public release should keep this work aspirational and research-first. Back to Fractalish

documents.title: MCVA / AMCVA Atlas - Fractalish
documents.headings: MCVA / AMCVA Atlas
documents.text: Public Materials MCVA / AMCVA Atlas The atlas is where the vocabulary becomes testable. If someone wants to use the work, this is one of the first places they should look. The atlas is the practical layer that turns the project from a set of ideas into a comparison workflow. MCVA is the positive readout side of the framework: the part that asks when morphology contains enough structure to support comparison, descriptor extraction, and process-memory hypotheses. AMCVA is the guardrail atlas: absent, erased, hidden, low-resolution, contaminated, misleading, or non-diagnostic form. The point of the atlas is not to say that trees, rivers, blood vessels, lightning, fractures, and dendrites all mean the same thing. The point is to build a disciplined comparison language for when morphology is present, and a disciplined refusal language for when it is not. The public atlas should grow through manifests first: source, rights, domain, subdomain, modality, descriptor tags, AMCVA boundary notes, and only then public assets where the publishing rights are actually clear. Without AMCVA and HOLD, a morphology-first framework drifts toward over-reading. The point is not to say every branching or fracture pattern means the same thing. The point is to preserve a disciplined comparison workflow when morphology is present and to preserve restraint when it is not. For contributors, the question here is straightforward: what examples belong, what descriptors matter, what counts as a useful negative case, and how should ambiguous morphology be routed into HOLD rather than forced into overclaim? If you are new to the project, read this page as the atlas, then read the Morphological Memory paper for the broader thesis, and then the Evidence Library for examples and edge cases. Continue with the Evidence Library , the whitepaper , and the glossary . Back to Fractalish

documents.title: Morphological Memory Paper - Fractalish
documents.headings: Morphological Memory Paper
documents.text: Public Materials Morphological Memory Paper The core wager is narrow: some structures preserve partial evidence about the processes that produced them. Morphological Memory Theory begins with a bounded claim: in some domains, observable form preserves partial evidence about the process that produced it. This does not imply: unique causal recovery, universal cross-domain equivalence, or diagnostic certainty. It does imply a research workflow: preserve morphology-bearing structures, measure them with explicit descriptors, compare them to baselines and candidate generated histories, preserve uncertainty where evidence is insufficient. This is the thesis layer of the project. If the atlas is where the work becomes operational, this paper is where the underlying intuition is stated as clearly and cautiously as possible. Morphological Memory Theory does not claim unique causal recovery, universal equivalence across all branching systems, or diagnostic certainty. It claims that form can sometimes function as a record: of stress, flow, branching pressure, damage, healing, depletion, or repeated attempts under constraint. The strongest public sentence remains simple: memory becomes geometry. Trails, scars, reinforcement, blockage, erosion, depletion, and repair can alter later behavior and therefore leave readable traces behind. This is why the project insists on MCVA, AMCVA, and HOLD rather than a single yes-no classification frame. Where morphology carries signal, read it carefully. Where it is absent, erased, hidden, or too weak, preserve restraint. In practice, this paper sits between the big worldview and the operational tooling. It explains why morphology matters, why uncertainty has to stay visible, and why HOLD and AMCVA are necessary if the framework is going to remain honest. For users and contributors, this page matters because it defines the focus. It explains what the project is trying to do, what it is not claiming to do, and why the project keeps insisting on comparison before commitment. The public version should stay close to explicit examples and falsifiable workflows rather than drifting into universal claims. Continue with the MCVA / AMCVA Atlas , the whitepaper , and the project map . Back to Fractalish

documents.text: Correction & Retraction Notice (July 13, 2026) Following an adversarial audit, this document has been corrected. We formally retract the claim of "bidirectional closure" (the Î _A+ operator is a lossy, forward readout, not bidirectional). We retract the use of the term "resonance" for the prototype, correcting it to "parameterized local-growth boundary condition." We correct the threshold inversion bug (the formula for Î¸_b has been inverted to match the prose). Finally, we clarify that the Specificity Receipt measures target compliance , not absolute truth, and that Seed 42 is a single deterministic trace, not a proof of robust morphology classes. The core M1 vertical slice remains verified, but the theoretical claims have been bounded. Research note | Corrected July 13, 2026 The Resonant Morphology Thesis Resonant Morphology connects a simple proposition across the Fractalish stack: a process can leave a structured form, that form can be read under constraint, and the adequacy of that reading can be measured before it is trusted. This places the thesis in both Cognitive Basin and Fractalish AI . It is a machine-cognition architecture note, a public implementation target, and a claim-boundary document. The governing question is not whether a form looks meaningful. The question is what process record survives in it, what can be read back, and how much debt remains. Fractalish AI An active AI architecture program Fractalish AI is presented here as an active AI architecture and implementation program: local-first, governed, replayable machine cognition designed to connect morphology, memory, measurement, and device evidence. This is not a claim of artificial personhood or proven sentience. Its present scope is architectural and experimental: testable slices, bounded claims, and reproducible evidence. Primary category Cognitive Basin and Fractalish AI Related lanes Natural Math, Specificity, Ageometrics, CNTM Status Public research note and implementation target Boundary Architecture and prototype evidence, not personhood The closure loop The thesis organizes a repeatable loop: A parameterized local-growth boundary condition constrains local process. Local growth proceeds through finite decisions, thresholds, trails, and restrictions. The resulting morphology becomes a structured record of what happened. A symbolic readout attempts to encode the form without asserting complete recovery. A specificity receipt measures what was preserved, what failed, and what governance state follows. The Cognitive Basin admits the result as evidence, feedback, warning, or HOLD rather than as an unexamined conclusion. Corrected threshold and forward readout The prototype's branching threshold is corrected to: Î¸_b = 2.8(T) + 1.5 The original draft used Î¸_b = 2.8(1 - T) + 1.5 , which mathematically lowered the threshold for high coherence and contradicted the prose. The corrected expression raises the threshold for high coherence, suppressing branching and favoring stability. The readout is lossy and forward-only. The symbol is deterministically recoverable from the discrete ternary vector, but tuple/glyph round-trip does not reconstruct the original simulated morphology. This is a bounded forward fixture, not bidirectional recovery. The prototype slice A local Natural Math / Construction A+ prototype, bifurcation_motif_v1.py , reproduces the following deterministic receipt for seed 42: Observation Reported result Segments 7 Bifurcations 3 Glyph ID 31433 PEFP digits [0, 1, 0, -1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1] GSR / NGR 0.8 / 0.2 Debt classification CAUTION Failed checklist item trail_density_ok The result is useful because the receipt preserves a visible failure and a nonzero debt state. The motif and symbolic readout are therefore carried forward as bounded evidence rather than unrestricted confirmation. The Specificity Receipt in this prototype measures target compliance against the declared checklist. It does not measure absolute truth, and Seed 42 remains a single deterministic trace rather than proof of robust morphology classes. A CAUTION output in one fixture is not a general solution to hallucination. Why this belongs in Cognitive Basin Cognitive Basin is where the result becomes governable. The prototype does not merely generate an output; it produces an evidence posture. The Basin can treat the receipt as structured feedback, preserve the failed condition, route the state into a bounded next action, and prevent an attractive pattern from becoming an unsupported claim. This is why Resonant Morphology belongs in the Basin lane: it is about admission, memory, state, feedback, and governed recurrence. Why this belongs in Fractalish AI Fractalish AI is the broader implementation program that asks whether morphology, memory, measurement, and device evidence can be joined into local machine cognition. Resonant Morphology gives that program a compact test shape: constrain local growth, produce a morphology, read it, score the reading, and carry the result forward under governance. That is AI work in the direct engineering sense: stateful systems, measured representations, bounded action, repair, replay, and evidence-aware decision loops. It is not a claim that the system has subjective experience. Claim boundary This note does not claim sentience, artificial personhood, physical CNTM memory, physical morphology memory, completed persistent intelligence, a universal morphology decoder, medical authority, or regulatory authority. It does claim that Fractalish AI can be described publicly as an active AI architecture and implementation program, and that the Resonant Morphology loop is specific enough to be built, run, criticized, replayed, and improved. The Pivot: Natural Math Leaf Morphogenesis The Resonant Morphology Prototype successfully demonstrated a deterministic generation-and-encoding pipeline. However, to test whether compact, species-specific local growth constraints can generate characteristic biological forms and preserve recoverable information about the rules that produced them, the project is immediately pivoting to the Natural Math Leaf Generator . The next phase will not claim bidirectional closure. It will execute a rigorous three-stage test: (1) Generate a generic leaf-like structure from local vein branching and blade filling without a pre-drawn outline. (2) Produce distinct rule families (e.g., palmate vs. pinnate) by altering the inherited Natural Math genome. (3) Execute the Inverse Test, feeding only the final graph topology into a classifier to see if it can identify the rule family that produced it. This is one bounded test of whether final topology preserves useful information about the rules that produced it. documents.text: An implementation branch Cognition should begin from what it has already earned. The Cognitive Basin explores what changes when relationships, contradictions, recovery routes, and unresolved questions persist across later reasoning. Unknown is not error. Unknown ≠ error Ambiguity ≠ permission to guess Suppressed ≠ erased A capable system needs somewhere to retain unresolved states without forcing them into false certainty. This is cognitive infrastructure, not merely a warning label. The architecture follows the question. Local preprocessing Cheap local modules should resolve ordinary distinctions before consuming central cognition. Formation Ledger An auditable graph or hypergraph can retain relations, uncertainty, contradiction, provenance, transfer, and causal credit without being presumed to execute cognition. Sparse recruitment Indexed formed susceptibilities should let present conditions wake a small relevant coalition rather than repeatedly searching everything retained. Background formation A low-cost process can watch unresolved contradictions, prediction failures, maintenance needs, and newly relevant memories. Current candidate: ledger for audit; Formative Field for execution. Both offices remain independently testable and demotable. Metabolism of history Memory is the old state encountering the current one. Reconsidering the same retained event at two different times can produce different consequences because the rememberer has changed. Later reconstruction must distinguish retained evidence, deterministic derivation, probabilistic inference, and context added later. M + present state 1 → consequence 1 M + present state 2 → consequence 2 Reflection requires inhibition. Repeatedly replaying the same material is not depth. Refractory periods, novelty requirements, replay budgets, diversity pressure, and reactivation by new evidence prevent a reflective system from becoming trapped. Maintenance without a survival drive. The system may observe memory corruption, sensor degradation, hardware wear, prediction decline, dependency failures, and lost recovery paths. That supports bounded maintenance; it does not authorize "preserve yourself at all costs." Do not impose persistence. Make healthy persistence the consequence of good formation. Current status Architecture under test. The Cognitive Basin and related software provide bounded evidence for persistent authority, contradiction handling, retained history, and later route consequences. They do not establish life, consciousness, or general intelligence. Open the technical Cognitive Basin page See the project evidence states

Recovery and transplant Allow recovery formation, transplant one recovery susceptibility into a naive twin without replaying the transcript, and demand its narrow predicted advantage. Ablation and baselines Ablate the transplanted susceptibility and demand disappearance of the effect. Compare against context, RAG, RETE, procedural memory, temporal knowledge graphs, and the same bare host at equal budget. This is a testable engineering hypothesis, not a universal learning law. Developmental-search advantage Machine-speed iteration improves the experiment, not the evidence status. The candidate loop is CLONE → PERTURB → EXPERIENCE → MEASURE → ABLATE → SELECT → TRANSFER. Generating histories is cheap; assigning causal credit is not. No fixed evolutionary-span or wall-clock prediction is earned. CF begins by withholding explanatory privilege from the categories already embedded in the question. The constitutive operation Suspension comes first. We do not begin by assuming the categories in the question are the categories in the territory. We temporarily withhold their explanatory privilege, preserve the observations, reconstruct what the observations require, and let familiar categories return only if they earn their way back. documents.text: Constitution | Version 0.1 | Adopted 2026-08-09 Methodological commitments inside Consequential Formation. Fractalish studies how past change becomes present structure and changes what can happen next. Consequential Formation is the current framework organizing that inquiry. The constitutional principles below preserve methodological commitments accumulated through earlier stages of the program. In that lineage: Form is accumulated consequence. Geometry is one way of measuring the receipt. Fractalish seeks the generative grammar upstream of accumulated form. Status: living constitutional record. These principles sit inside Consequential Formation; they do not form a competing public thesis or declare a completed theory of nature. Constitutional Center Fractalish studies the processes by which observable organization comes to exist, persists, changes, repairs, reconstructs, and constrains what can happen next. Accumulated Form is an observable state whose present organization is the retained consequence of prior transitions, interactions, constraints, perturbations, selections, persistence, release, and history. Form is evidence. Form is not automatically explanation. The "ish" The fractal was a clue. The "ish" is the search upstream of observable form for the relations and operations that produced it. Representation No representation is privileged. Geometry, topology, morphology, graphs, spectra, state spaces, phase spaces, and traces are instruments with residue. First verb GO / STOP / HOLD and PERMIT / INHIBIT / PRESERVE are candidate hypotheses, not established universal primitives. Experimental recursion Description reads the receipt. Intervention tests the grammar. Fractalish works backward from accumulated form to infer formative operations and forward through experiment to determine whether those inferred operations actually generate, predict, arrest, preserve, repair, redirect, or reconstruct consequential organization. The central intervention question is: what change in the conditions of persistence makes the existing form no longer self-maintaining? Possibility Multiple futures may be accessible before a consequential transition. Constraint Operations and interactions change what can happen next. Persistence Some consequences remain active after the initiating event passes. Perturbation Changing the suspected relation tests whether the inferred grammar has causal value. Evidence Discipline Similarity is not mechanism Visual resemblance can motivate a hypothesis, but it does not establish shared cause. Unobserved does not mean zero Failure of an instrument to observe something is not evidence that the thing is absent. HOLD before false closure Negative findings, failed experiments, counterexamples, and unresolved questions remain part of lineage. Desiloization Decompartmentalization without decontextualization. Disciplines are metadata, not walls. Cross-domain abstraction must never overwrite domain-native terminology, mechanism, scale, uncertainty, provenance, or failure modes. Claim Boundary This Constitution does not claim a universal grammar of nature, proof that nature is fundamentally fractal, proof that GO / STOP / HOLD are universal primitives, proof of machine consciousness, proof of artificial life, equivalence between biological and artificial systems based on resemblance, causal inference from morphology alone, semantic truth from traces, a universal decoder, or completion of the Fractalish research program. Read the repository Constitution Read governance

documents.text: Constitutional principle | Updated August 2026 Desiloization Decompartmentalization without decontextualization. Status Constitutional principle Purpose Compare across domains without erasing source context Claim boundary Similarity is not identity Version / date Current public guide | August 2026 Fractalish rejects disciplinary compartmentalization as a boundary on inquiry. Nature is not organized according to university departments, journal categories, grant programs, professions, commercial sectors, or inherited vocabularies. Specialization is useful and must be preserved. But specialization must not become epistemic insulation. Disciplines are metadata, not walls. Specialization is an instrument of precision. Epistemic insulation is a source of blindness. Every claim must travel with its trace and its source context. Guardrails Similarity is not identity. Visual resemblance is insufficient. Shared vocabulary is insufficient. Mathematical resemblance is insufficient. Every source domain must retain its terminology, mechanism, scale, boundary conditions, uncertainty, provenance, and failure modes. Cross-domain abstraction must be stored separately from the domain-native account. A candidate correspondence must earn relevance through prediction, perturbation, reconstruction, invariant preservation, transfer, independent recurrence, or residue accounting. Invitation Researchers, skeptics, domain experts, public works people, students, artists, engineers, and outsiders are invited to challenge, test, extend, and correct the vocabulary. If your field has already named one of these geometries, bring the name. If your field has data, bring the data. If our interpretation fails, submit the failure. Proof-negative cases are as valuable as proof-positive cases because AMCVA is how the system refuses false geometry. Contribute a critique or case Follow @fractalish_com

documents.text: Docs / Fractal Math Primer Useful anchors, not the whole story. Fractal dimension measures scaling complexity. It does not identify morphology by itself. Canonical families such as Koch, Sierpinski, Hilbert, dragon, branching trees, and Mandelbrot-like boundaries help define the alphabet. Physical morphology becomes the language. Fractalish therefore uses fractal dimension alongside topology, lacunarity, anisotropy, symmetry, periodicity, branch structure, and SVG trace geometry.

documents.headings: Fractalish must read the whole geometric field.
documents.text: Docs / Guardrails Fractalish must read the whole geometric field. Nature does not speak only in fractals. Fractalish does not claim that every natural pattern is fractal. Nature uses many geometries. Fractalish studies when morphology preserves process information, and AMCVA marks when that information is absent, hidden, erased, dominated by another geometry, or not yet readable. MCVA reads preserved process. AMCVA prevents hallucinated process.

documents.text: CF's first operation Suspend the inherited category. Keep the evidence. Category suspension is constitutive of Consequential Formation, not an optional lens beside it. Human knowledge is a map drawn on the cave wall. Some lines mark real cliffs. Some mark useful trails. Some carry historical assumptions or compress several phenomena into one label. CF temporarily withholds a line's explanatory privilege and looks at the territory again. A noun that was never removed cannot be said to have survived the CF filter. Removing a word does not remove observations, ban ordinary language, or prove the category false. The current operation SUSPEND OBSERVE DISTINGUISH TRACE CHANGE TRACE RETENTION MAP CONSTRAINT MAP REACHABILITY AUDIT INDEPENDENCE RECONSTRUCT TYPE THE RETURN RENAME ONLY IF EARNED The category must earn its way back twice Boundary test Does observation or intervention force some version of the distinction back? Independence test Can the returned concept be defined without importing the other relations reconstructed with it? Type the return Classify it as PRIMITIVE, OFFICE, INDEX, OPERATOR, COMPOSITE / EMERGENT, COMPRESSION NOUN, or OPEN DEBT. Test the consequence State a prediction, intervention, native comparison, or kill condition. Remove the old noun. Reconstruct. Then remove our new noun too. Try it on one system Name a system, event, object, or question Open the full worksheet Rules that keep the method honest Keep native mathematics Removing a noun is not permission to flatten domain-specific equations or discard established controls. Permit incomparability and no change Two domains may share a signature while lacking a valid mapping. INCOMPARABLE, UNSUPPORTED, METHOD FAILED, and NO CHANGE are legitimate results. Audit our vocabulary too Reachability, closure, access, recoverability, formation, constraint, and distinction are not immune from the same test.

documents.text: Field Guide The vocabulary before the larger papers and code. Start here if you want the language of the project before the research notes, specifications, and implementation details. Canonical fractals become the alphabet. Physical morphology becomes the language. Every claim must travel with its trace. What is Fractalish? Fractalish asks whether visible form can preserve process memory strongly enough to support disciplined comparison. It studies roads, cracks, vessels, roots, lightning, surfaces, channels, signals, and other systems as possible records of prior constraint, damage, adaptation, and recovery. It does not claim that all morphology is readable, and it does not collapse every pattern into one universal explanation. Accidental longitudinal morphology Most institutions did not set out to build morphology registries. They simply kept taking pictures while inspecting roads, bridges, forests, bodies, factories, and landscapes. Fractalish treats those secondary-frame records as a potential evidence layer. Repeated images beat perfect images. Sequences explain what one frame can only suggest. Fractal dimension is not enough Box counting, lacunarity, multifractal descriptors, and boundary metrics can be useful. None is sufficient by itself. Two images can share a fractal-dimension neighborhood while preserving very different process histories. See the microglia precedent note for a concrete reminder that subtle morphology demands multiple descriptors and acquisition guardrails. Every claim travels with its trace Fractalish is not satisfied with aesthetic resemblance. The working standard is evidence packages: image, segmentation, trace, metrics, routing, and provenance. That is how a comparison becomes inspectable rather than impressionistic. Desiloizing geometry Road engineers, cardiologists, metallurgists, foresters, and signal researchers often describe related geometry with incompatible vocabularies. Fractalish tries to build the translation layer, not by erasing domain knowledge but by reconnecting it. Read Desiloizing Geometry Core field guides Natural Math - the forward or generative layer. MCVA / AMCVA / HOLD - the public vocabulary and guardrail system. Videos / Study Guides - video-supported learning with accessible timed subtitles and study notes.

documents.text: Overview | Updated July 2026 Fractalish AI Fractalish AI is the device-facing branch of the project: local state, governed action, real sensors, replayable sessions, and machine cognition built under physical constraint. BasinLab is the local execution environment at the center of that effort. Fractalish AI is being framed as an emergence problem under hard conditions: bounded hardware, local persistence, real sensors, and explicit governance rather than abstract chatbot theater. Real hardware, real constraints BasinLab is the local execution environment BasinLab refers to the environment we are trying to bring into existence on device: local, retained, governed, replayable, and materially constrained by the handset it runs on. The point is not to port a web demo onto Android. The point is to cultivate a native execution environment that can sense, decide, persist, replay, and recover on real hardware. Status Active Current device path Stock Android groundwork and Motorola device evidence Architecture rule Rebuild mobile-native, do not naively port desktop stack Core posture Local-first, governed, sensor-rich, bounded Formal AI posture Fractalish AI is an active AI architecture and implementation program: local-first, governed, replayable machine cognition built around morphology, memory, measurement, and device evidence. The Resonant Morphology Thesis adds a compact test loop for that posture: constrain local growth, produce a morphology, read it symbolically, score what was preserved, and admit the result into governance without hiding the remaining debt. What Fractalish AI reuses cleanly From AIA Android shell pattern, stock-device acceptance workflow, local-only bias, device receipts, and build toolchain expectations. From Cognitive Basin Epistemic and action-state canon, governed ActionProposal , replayable event logs, Basin updates, narrative/review structure, and local session logic. From Natural Math A separate deterministic process engine with EXTEND , SENSE , and RESTRICT , event histories, parameter profiles, and formal source material. From Fractalish The outward morphology vocabulary and the discipline that not every visible pattern should be over-read into a claim. What must be rebuilt for phone The execution backend must become mobile-native rather than desktop subprocess-oriented. The service surface should prefer an embedded local app architecture over desktop-style local HTTP assumptions. The Natural Math runtime should remain a distinct engine and can be re-authored natively instead of blindly transliterated. Heavy desktop acceptance harnesses should become smaller deterministic mobile traces. Recommended mobile architecture Layer Purpose Activation Shell Own lifecycle, local storage, review UI, replay/export, and session control. Basin Core Mobile Implement Cognitive Basin enums, governed actions, session event log, prediction/residual tracking, and replayable state reconstruction. Natural Math Engine Run distinct local-process simulations under EXTEND / SENSE / RESTRICT without collapsing into Basin governance. Bridge Layer Translate Natural Math outputs into Basin observations, anomalies, tensions, and planning signals. Best first phone slice Start an activation session with a purpose anchor. Run one local Natural Math simulation profile. Convert simulation outputs into Cognitive Basin observations. Produce governed state updates and next-step proposals. Persist replayable session history on device. Export a redacted trace bundle. Current direction The direction is straightforward: keep state locally, admit bounded inputs, generate governed actions, preserve history, and make the system survive contact with actual hardware instead of only a browser tab. documents.text: Technical metric page Home / Ageometrics / Geometric Sufficiency Ratio Geometric Sufficiency Ratio GSR measures how much target-relevant predictive value survives a declared geometric compression under a controlled comparator protocol. A GSR estimate without a comparator protocol is not an Ageometrics result. Metric status Decision-theoretic working paper metric Version 0.5 Attribution Synaptient Known risk Comparator imbalance can mimic residue 1. Concise definition GSR is a task-relative ratio comparing the risk reduction preserved by a declared geometric representation against the risk reduction available from a declared fuller reference record. 2. Why comparator discipline matters The central failure mode is easy to state and easy to miss: if the geometry-only path is evaluated with one learner family and the fuller record with a stronger one, the measured gap may reflect learner advantage rather than representational insufficiency. Same cases, same temporal boundary, declared control of learner and capacity, then a paired estimate with uncertainty. 3. Declared objects X : declared fuller reference record available at prediction or decision time G(X) : specified geometric representation derived from X B : declared baseline information or baseline predictor Y : target ell : declared loss, with lower preferred Pi : complete empirical comparison protocol 4. Canonical Bayes-risk definition R*_ell(Z) = inf_f E[ell(Y, f(Z))] GSR*_{ell,Y}(G | X,B) = [R*_ell(B) - R*_ell(G(X))] / [R*_ell(B) - R*_ell(X)] R*_ell(B) > R*_ell(X) 5. Boundedness assumptions R*_ell(X) <= R*_ell(G(X)) <= R*_ell(B) When the geometry is derived from the fuller record, the fuller record can reproduce the geometry-only decision rule, and the geometry is at least as informative as the baseline, the canonical population quantity is bounded: 0 <= GSR* <= 1 Boundedness is not automatic when those assumptions fail. 6. Empirical protocol-specific estimator GSR_hat_Pi = [R_hat_Pi(B) - R_hat_Pi(G)] / [R_hat_Pi(B) - R_hat_Pi(X)] The three empirical risks should be evaluated on the same held-out cases, under the same temporal-availability rules, with declared comparator controls and leakage safeguards. 7. Same-learner, approximately capacity-matched, and model-envelope views Same-learner GSR: the same declared predictive family, preprocessing policy, search budget, partitions, and stopping rule are applied when technically possible. This holds much of the observer and protocol fixed while remaining observer- and architecture-relative. Approximately capacity-matched GSR: when input forms require different model families, parameter count, training compute, data exposure, tuning effort, regularization, and stopping criteria are matched as closely as practicable and the remaining asymmetries are reported. Model-envelope GSR: several credible predictive families are reported to expose observer dependence. This is a robustness-oriented view, not an automatically conservative one. 8. Worked 0.75 / 0.80 / 0.95 example Accuracy form: (0.80 - 0.75) / (0.95 - 0.75) = 0.25 Error-risk form: (0.25 - 0.20) / (0.25 - 0.05) = 0.25 Raw geometry-only performance can sound strong while still preserving only a small share of the recoverable improvement. 9. Empirical interval violations Empirical estimates below 0 or above 1 can occur because of finite samples, regularization, optimization, model mismatch, or comparator imbalance. These values are diagnostic and should be preserved, not silently clipped. 10. Canonical and empirical NGR Canonical NGR is bounded only under the canonical assumptions. Empirical NGR is signed and protocol-relative. NGR* = 1 - GSR* NGR_hat_Pi = 1 - GSR_hat_Pi NGR is not a metaphysical non-geometric substance. It is a target-, representation-, loss-, and protocol-relative performance gap. 11. Information-theoretic companion GSR^I_Y(G | X) = I(G(X);Y) / I(X;Y) This companion connects Ageometrics to Information Bottleneck thinking. It is not the default empirical estimator because high-dimensional mutual information can be unstable to estimate. 12. Interventional GSR Interventional GSR asks how much of intervention-response prediction survives geometric compression, rather than passive observation alone. 13. Temporal GSR Temporal GSR asks how much target-relevant information remains when developmental or event history is compressed into final-state or trajectory geometry. 14. Representation-stability envelope One geometry is rarely enough. The representation-stability envelope summarizes GSR across a family of admissible geometric representations of the same record. A wide envelope means the sufficiency claim depends too heavily on representation choice. 15. Encoding cost A geometry that becomes sufficient only after heavy augmentation may no longer be a meaningful compression. Encoding cost forces a harder question: did the geometry expose structure, or did it merely absorb timestamps, labels, provenance, and interventions until it became a renamed full record? 16. Minimal residue-restoring channel A useful benchmark can ask what smallest auxiliary channel restores sufficiency above a declared threshold. That channel identifies what the geometry was missing. 17. Benchmark protocol At minimum, an Ageometrics benchmark should declare the fuller reference record, the geometry, the baseline, the target, the loss, the temporal boundary, the learner controls, the uncertainty method, and the leakage-risk plan. 18. Statistical cautions Comparator unfairness Model-class confounding Target leakage and future information Geometry smuggling through labels or timestamps Small-denominator instability 19. Open questions Which proper losses are best by domain? How should uncertainty be propagated for ratio estimators? How should model-envelope results be aggregated? When are cross-domain comparisons meaningful? 20. Downloads and citation Current working paper Current PDF Illustration code Repository root The population quantity and the empirical estimate should never be spoken of as if they were the same object.

documents.text: Consequential Formation v0.4 RC1 Fractalish Fractalish studies how what happens leaves a difference, and how that difference changes what can happen next. Human knowledge comes pre-divided: life / non-life, mind / matter, physical / informational, machine / organism, memory / structure. Fractalish temporarily removes those labels, preserves the observations, measurements, relationships, and constraints underneath them, then asks which boundaries the evidence forces us to reconstruct. Consequential Formation is the framework. CF v0.4 RC1 is the current canonical candidate, not a frozen theory or a declaration of discovery. Suspending inherited categories is its constitutive investigative operation. The projects are experiments, implementations, evidence, and historical formation. Follow the rounds See the framework inherited line evidence-tested line The cave wall The lines are not the territory. Some lines in human knowledge mark real cliffs. Some mark useful trails. Some were drawn because earlier travelers needed them. Some were copied so many times that nobody remembers why they are there. Erasing a line does not prove it was wrong. If the observations force us to redraw it in the same place, the boundary has survived the test. The operation Suspend the category. Keep the evidence. Audit what returns. 1 Withhold the inherited category 2 Preserve observations and native relations 3 Reconstruct consequential structure 4 Audit independence and type the return A familiar category may return unchanged, return with a different office, split, merge, or fail to return. Even when it returns, CF asks whether it can stand independently or only compresses a mutually constituted set of relations. Remove the old noun. Reconstruct. Then remove our new noun too. What kept returning One relation survived across very different questions. change retained consequence altered constraint changed future possibilities Something happens. The event leaves something behind. What remains changes the conditions of the present. Those conditions alter what can happen next. We call this recurring framework Consequential Formation : trace what an occurrence leaves behind, how that retained difference alters present constraints, and how those constraints change reachable futures. Form is accumulated consequence. What v0.4 RC1 changes The record of formation is not presumed to be its runtime. documents.text: Life without starting from "life" When does an arrangement begin maintaining the conditions for its own continuation? That question turns a familiar noun into an operational research program. Why we asked The label arrives before the mechanism. Calling something living identifies a useful class, but does not by itself specify which organizational operations produce the transition. What survived Self-maintenance, restoration, closure, and viable routes. A living organization may be understood as one whose ongoing processes help maintain or reconstruct the conditions required for those processes to continue. Candidate reconstruction Life ≈ self-maintaining constraint closure This is a candidate operational framework, not settled biology. It must be connected to independently measurable variables and compared against existing theories of living organization. The organism boundary The organism may be the closure, not the components. Atoms are continually replaced. What persists is an organization of mutually maintaining processes and constraints. The open question is whether an organism's boundary should follow its skin or the closure of dependencies required to maintain it. process maintains constraint constraint sustains process Autonomy handoff Who is paying for this constraint now? External support energy regulation repair calibration control → Internal maintenance constraint sensing restoration adaptation bounded action An autonomy handoff occurs when responsibility for maintaining a required constraint shifts from an external source toward the organization itself. It can be partial and multidimensional. Origin and death on one map Origin Internally maintained viable reachability appears or grows. Life The organization reconstructs conditions that keep viable routes open. Damage Reachability narrows, but recovery routes remain. Dormancy Activity approaches zero while recoverable organization remains. Death No declared route returns the organization to viable self-maintenance. "No route" is relative to stated resources, interventions, horizon, and model. This is an operational hypothesis, not a universal mathematical solution to death. What would kill it The closure must add discriminating power. The proposal weakens if closure variables cannot be measured, fail to distinguish matched living and nonliving systems, or add no prediction or intervention advantage beyond existing biological accounts. CANDIDATE OPERATIONAL FRAMEWORK The biotic/abiotic boundary remains useful. CF asks for the measurable transition rather than assuming the noun has explained it.

documents.text: Field Guide | Updated June 2026 MCVA / AMCVA / HOLD MCVA reads where morphology preserves process. AMCVA protects where it does not. HOLD preserves uncertainty when the evidence is not enough yet. Status Field Guide Purpose Public explanation of readable signal, non-signal, and justified uncertainty Claim boundary Interpretation is conditional, never forced Core guardrail A fractal reading is not forced. It must be earned. What this is: a disciplined vocabulary for where morphology may safely speak, where it does not safely speak, and where the honest answer is still "not yet." What this is not: a license to impose a process reading on every pattern, every image, or every noisy dataset. MCVA MCVA stands for morphology-constrained vocabulary analysis. It applies to cases where morphology is sufficiently preserved, segmented, and contextualized to support cautious process interpretation. AMCVA AMCVA is not a failure state. It is how the system refuses false geometry. Often it means the trace may be present, but the measurement stack is not trustworthy enough yet. AMCVA-A: Absence No readable morphology is present: blank fields, uniform surfaces, or insufficient visible structure. AMCVA-O: Obscuration The morphology may exist but is hidden by blur, low resolution, glare, shadow, compression, noise, or segmentation failure. AMCVA-E: Erasure Morphology was likely removed or overwritten through polishing, resurfacing, healing, erosion, filtering, cleanup, or threshold collapse. AMCVA-D: Domain mismatch Structure exists, but the current vocabulary cannot responsibly interpret it without stronger domain baselines or process metadata. AMCVA-G: Geometric dominance A non-fractal or competing geometric regime dominates the image: grid, lattice, wave, ring, spiral, Voronoi packing, lamination, and so on. AMCVA-C: Competing geometry Fractalish-like morphology may be present, but another geometry interferes with interpretation. AMCVA-K: Complementary geometry Another geometry helps explain the visible morphology rather than simply obscuring it. AMCVA-H: Human/capture artifact The visible structure is likely produced or strongly distorted by camera angle, lens behavior, compression, stitching, thresholding, interface overlay, or other capture artifacts. HOLD HOLD preserves uncertainty. Use it when the case may be relevant but the evidence is ambiguous, the segmentation is weak, the baseline is missing, or better timepoints could materially change the interpretation. Guardrails A fractal reading is not forced. It must be earned. Similarity is not identity. Fractal dimension is not enough. AMCVA does not mean nothing is there. It often means the trace is present, but the measurement stack is not yet trustworthy. Natural Math Fractalish Commons Recovery Wake note Desiloizing Geometry

documents.headings: A crack remembers. That does not make the crack intelligent. A durable consequence changes a future response. Storage is not enough. Each step adds an operation. documents.text: From history to possible futures A crack remembers. That does not make the crack intelligent. Retaining history is an early operation. Intelligence requires more. Memory without starting from "memory" A durable consequence changes a future response. Memory = durable consequence that changes future reachability Synaptic change, scar tissue, hysteresis, configuration state, machine state, and contradiction history can all retain consequential history. This primitive sense must not be confused with human autobiographical memory. The Markov safeguard: if two systems are identical in every causally relevant present variable under a complete description, undocumented history cannot make them behave differently. History matters because its consequences remain instantiated. Learning Storage is not enough. A system has learned only when prior history changes what it can or will do later. A passive record may document an event without changing the recorder's future response. The consequential intelligence ladder Each step adds an operation. transition retention constraint reachability adaptation prediction counterfactual selection revision The candidate thesis is that intelligence increases with the depth, breadth, and temporal reach of a system's ability to construct, compare, select, enact, and revise reachable futures. CANDIDATE This does not replace standard cognitive science or imply that all history-sensitive matter is intelligent. Engineering distinction Capability, host policy, and formation are different variables. A host reasoner may already possess language, mathematics, coding, simulation, tool-use capability, and habits such as checking, hedging, or decomposition. Neither the capability nor those spontaneous policies automatically constitute a developing machine's acquired formed history. CAPABILITY != HOST POLICY != ACQUIRED FORMATION A machine can begin with powerful tools and strong default habits while still having almost no individual formed history of its own. Bare-host policy must be profiled before a behavior change is credited to formation. Consciousness Find the additional operation. CF has not solved consciousness. If consciousness is a true causal discontinuity, candidate discriminators include recursive self-modeling, global integration, temporal unity, self/world distinction, metacognitive access, counterfactual depth, and reportability. Identity Inheritance is not numerical identity. Material continuity and pattern similarity are each insufficient. A successor can carry enormous formation from an earlier system without automatically being the same individual. What would kill it The ladder must discriminate. If the proposed stages cannot distinguish matched systems, predict interventions, or explain capability changes better than existing constructs, the ladder should be revised or abandoned. Open problem No threshold for consciousness or numerical identity has been earned.

documents.text: Open Release Doctrine Public first, but not careless. This release is public-first. The aim is to establish a public record, make the ideas usable, invite criticism and improvement, and reduce the chance that the framework disappears behind obscurity or gatekeeping. The core position is straightforward: the core vocabulary is open, the core tools are open, the core atlas method is open, the core documentation is open. The core framework is open. If this work helps you, support it, cite it, contribute back, sponsor development, or hire us to apply it. This release is not framed as patent pending, commercial lock-in, proprietary atlas access, a finished product, or a universal theory. Open release does not mean free labor forever. Sustainability can come from voluntary support, sponsored development, implementation help, training, hosted tools, custom morphology reports, domain-specific analysis, and donations. Do not publish private prompts, unpublished legal strategy, private medical or financial material, tokens, keys, secrets, or unlicensed third-party datasets. Back to Fractalish

documents.text: Current project within Consequential Formation Persistent Observer How much consequential state can survive transfer between hosts while evidence, contradiction, governance, and action authority remain inspectable? Learnable novelty estimates the reusable structure a bounded observer can extract. This project asks what should be preserved, how an encounter should alter future accessibility, what consequences must remain attached, and which actions remain impermissible regardless of informational value. Project hierarchy: Natural Math, Ageometrics, UFWK, Cognitive Basin, Bolt-On, and host continuity are mixed-status components and records used by this project. They are not the public definition of Fractalish. Claim boundary: This page joins frozen software results, locally validated prototypes, code-present structures, formal specifications, and proposed integrations. Their statuses remain separate. No complete persistent observer operating end to end inside a production language-model service is claimed. Central distinction: A metric scores an encounter. A persistent observer is changed by it, inspectably, reversibly, and with receipts. Missing step Learnable novelty Finite to persistent Architecture Exists now Provisional Experiment Negative results Why build it Neighbors Collaborate Evidence Question How much consequential state can survive transfer between hosts? Current approach A governed persistent-observer and PIA architecture with receipts, contradiction history, replay, and host-owned action. Status Proposed integration architecture with mixed-status components. Evidence Frozen and locally validated component evidence is linked on this page and in Documents. Open problem Demonstrate the complete sequence in a declared production host without collapsing evidence, interpretation, or execution authority. The missing step after learnability Extracted structure still needs custody. Learnability can say that an observer extracted reusable structure. It does not, by itself, say which target made that structure relevant, what evidence was preserved, what residue remains, what later accessibility should change, or what action remains blocked. A metric scores an encounter. A persistent observer changes future reach under receipts and review. What learnable novelty contributes A candidate signal, not a governor. External reported result Epiplexity From Entropy to Epiplexity separates structure learnable by a bounded observer from surprise that remains unlearnable under that observer and model class. Fractalish records this as neighboring external work, not a locally reproduced result. Claims: CLAIM-0083 and CLAIM-0084. External reported result Learnable novelty Intelligence from Learnable Novelty reports a reservoir-based closed-form estimator or approximation of epiplexity using a fixed bounded observer. Co-evolving observers and LLM substrates remain proposed future work. Claims: CLAIM-0085 through CLAIM-0091. Limitation Intrinsic signal is not a target The reported Acrobot result is treated here as evidence that intrinsic learnability is not a substitute for a declared target. MNIST labels were absent from training but used for evaluation. From the finite observer to the persistent observer Operational complexity is conditioned by the observer. Yanbo Zhang's Age of Subjectivity and the subsequent work with Michael Levin place the finite observer at the center of complexity: structure is complex to the extent that a bounded observer can extract and reuse it. Their learnable-novelty estimator gives that insight a practical computational form. Fractalish begins from a closely neighboring premise but follows a different systems question. Once an observer extracts structure, what should remain attached to it? Which target made it relevant? What evidence and residue were preserved or lost? How should contradiction alter the record? How should the encounter change future accessibility? And what prevents an intrinsic learning signal from acquiring authority over action? We therefore treat learnable novelty as a candidate signal inside a larger persistent-observer architecture, not as truth, value, memory, or governance by itself. Layer distinction: Objectivity and subjectivity belong at different layers. Evidence should be preserved as exactly and inspectably as possible. Interpretation remains observer-, target-, context-, history-, and protocol-relative. UFWK line: Immutable evidence; revisable interpretation. Complexity is not necessarily created by the observer, but operational measurement is conditioned by capacity, history, target, and protocol. The proposed integration experiment Can transient learnable structure produce governed persistent accessibility? PROPOSED INTEGRATION The learnable-novelty soliton result motivates a future experiment: can transient learnable structures produce persistent, receipt-governed changes in later accessibility? Baseline. Run an untouched host, summary-only memory, vector-only memory, recency-only memory, and learnable-novelty-only arms. Read-only sidecar. Attach a neutral adapter that can observe and normalize events but cannot execute native host actions. Receipts. We did not begin with an AI theory and then attach a social vision. We began from the conviction that free knowledge and universal education are load-bearing requirements of a survivable post-labor transition. When we examined the systems that would have to carry that knowledge, we found drift, silent rewrite, broken continuity, and uninspectable authority. The exact-state, receipt-governed, host-authority-preserving architecture grew from the need to make a future knowledge commons trustworthy. documents.text: The method turns on knowledge itself What formation does a question inherit before anyone answers it? Words, equations, software, institutions, and evaluation rules carry history forward. Language and communication A word is a cue into formed structure. A token does not need to contain its full meaning. A formed receiver and present context help reconstruct the consequential state it evokes. That is why the same word can do different work for different receivers. rich state serial prose tokens receiver reconstruction Machines may not always need this costly human route. That motivates structured transfer, but does not prove it will be cheaper or more faithful. Recorded history as formation Influence is not truth. Historical influence ≠ truth Popularity ≠ truth Suppression ≠ erasure A rejected theory may still shape terminology. A false model may still produce technology. A forgotten source may alter later work indirectly. The research therefore seeks provenance richer than citation counts. Factorize, do not forget Compile relationships instead of repeatedly deleting context. The candidate approach preserves claims, dependencies, provenance, contradictions, uncertainty, validity conditions, predicted intervention responses, and recovery routes in reusable structures. The goal is not shorter prose. It is to avoid repeatedly reconstructing the same formation. Only after this question is understood do the project names Historical Consequential Compilation, Consequential Intermediate Representation, and Consequential Reachability Object become useful. Address Regression Before solving the question, inspect its Address. A scientific problem arrives with definitions, assumptions, variables, approximation regimes, equations, measurement procedures, boundary conditions, historical choices, and evaluation criteria. Address Regression traces those dependencies upstream before committing extraordinary intelligence to the inherited formulation. CANDIDATE METHOD - NOT YET EARNED The Navier-Stokes exercise largely returned the inherited mathematics. That is a successful outcome: the method must be allowed to say the old formulation was mostly good. Representation debt Does the inherited formulation make the work harder than it needs to be? Some problems may carry hidden dependencies or unnecessary representational structure. The test is whether upstream dependency compilation reduces downstream search, verification, reasoning cost, memory, tokens, or energy. No such general advantage is currently established. What would kill it Run matched comparisons. If native methods solve and verify the same tasks as well or better, if dependency tracing adds overhead without benefit, or if structured transfer loses decisive context, the proposed method should be demoted. A later 256-seed extension produced 171/256 successes, or 66.8%, with a Wilson 95% interval of about 60.8%-72.3%. The four 64-seed blocks were 44/64, 45/64, 41/64, and 41/64. What changed What changed World side scaled as 17*s, agents as 18*s^2, horizon as 512*s, formation lifetime as 7*s, and material feed per tick as s^2. The number and duration of possible local causal histories increased with scale. Total cycling and transported-reuse reliability increased across the tested range. What stayed frozen What did not change Movement score, carry rule, trace rule, formation rule, maintenance priority, dissolution rule, work rule, local costs, relation count, and tie-break. Movement remained one edge per tick. Local formation, movement, maintenance, and work costs remained unchanged. Cargo capacity remained three units of ordinary conserved material. No global planner, global map, curiosity bonus, future-state representation, or broadcast knowledge was added. Why it matters Why it matters A capability can be opportunity-limited rather than rule-limited. Scale can change the space of admissible local causal histories even when the local rule does not change. Before adding reasoning complexity to an unreliable system, test topology, lifetime, resource availability, transport, sparse encounter rate, and the number of independent causal histories. What did not improve Normalized work per agent-tick declined: about 0.01324 at x1, 0.00970 at x2, and 0.00867 at x3. The evidence does not show that scale made the system uniformly more efficient. The x1 transported-reuse result did not change and was not repaired. Causal and diagnostic audit Negative and diagnostic results Maintenance-first ordering Maintenance-first preserved sustained cycling but suppressed many moves that had been selected and were affordable before maintenance. World size, population, horizon, lifetime, and input schedule scaled together, so this release does not isolate which scaling dimension caused the reliability change. The result belongs to this deterministic integer-discrete mechanism and its declared conditions. The local-condition audits identify necessary and diagnostic conditions, not a complete causal decomposition of every failed seed. Not established What is not established Arbitrary-scale continuation or a universal scaling law. Improved normalized efficiency. Intelligence, life, consciousness, or biological reproduction. documents.text: Working technical note v0.1 Beyond Learnable Novelty From observer-relative structure to weighted persistent understanding. Boundary: this note identifies learnable novelty as a candidate signal inside a broader governed architecture. It does not claim that the complete architecture is already implemented end to end. Download Markdown Abstract Learnable novelty formalizes the reusable structure that a computationally bounded observer can extract from data and supplies a differentiable estimator that can be optimized across dynamical systems, representations, and agents. Fractalish treats this as an important but incomplete stage of intelligence: extraction without persistent, governed integration. A persistent observer must retain not only what was learnable, but the evidence and conditions under which an interpretation was formed; the observer, target, scale, and protocol; uncertainty and representational residue; contradiction and correction history; downstream consequence; counterfactual uncertainty; and the way the encounter should alter future accessibility. The bounded observer is necessary but not sufficient Let an observer receive data conditioned on prior context. Learnable novelty identifies reusable structure that the bounded observer can acquire and reuse. That is a useful measure of observer-relative extractable structure. It does not, by itself, specify what should happen to the observer after the structure is extracted. Fractalish therefore treats learnability as a candidate input to weighting, not as a complete governance system. Persistent understanding as changed accessibility A persistent observer is a history-bearing system in which an encounter can produce inspectable, versioned changes to future accessibility, retrieval, caution, association, correction, and action posture. B_(t+1) = Pi_G(B_t, E_t, W_t) The update rule above is an architectural contract, not a universal law. The point of the public note is the separation of evidence, weights, governance, replay, and action boundary. The WeightReceipt For an encounter, observer, target, context, and time, UFWK specifies a structured field with structural, contextual, affective-significance, prospective, consequential, mnemonic, residual, and counterfactual dimensions. An uncertainty envelope travels beside it. A task-specific routing projection may be derived from the field, but it must never replace the underlying field. Why learnability is one signal, not the governor Learnable novelty may contribute to structural significance, observer-relative novelty, prospective learning value, and mnemonic priority. It must remain distinct from evidentiary support, truth, authority, causal responsibility, moral value, rights, and action permission. The Acrobot result matters precisely because it shows that intrinsic learnability can conflict with a declared task objective. That is evidence for separation of candidate signal and governance, not an indictment of the measure. Deterministic integrity, Cognitive Basin, and host-independent continuity Natural Math contributes exact local transitions, deterministic receipts, replay, lineage, and fail-closed integrity. Cognitive Basin is the routing layer that turns approved receipts into changed accessibility. Bolt-On separates continuity from the current host so portable semantics survive host replacement while execution remains host-owned. Experimental design and falsification The main comparison is between stateless, summary-based, vector-based, novelty-only, and history-bearing observers under contradiction, correction, delay, and host substitution. The stronger claim should be narrowed or rejected if simpler memory baselines perform as well, weights prove unstable, receipt overhead dominates benefit, or substitution cannot preserve protected evidence. Key points Microglial form and function are linked, and subtle intermediate forms matter. Traditional categories are often too blunt to capture the actual variation. Box counting, lacunarity, and multifractal methods can quantify morphology that simple labels flatten. Fractal dimension is not unique or complete. It does gain a serious methodological precedent: subtle morphology can require multiple descriptors, intermediate states matter, and acquisition or preprocessing can easily damage interpretability. documents.text: Research Note | Updated June 2026 The Recovery Wake Is the Evidence A Fractalish research note on bifurcation, constraint, semi-recovery states, and downstream memory marks in morphology and signals. Status Research Note Purpose Timestamped hypothesis and descriptor roadmap Version / date Current note | June 2026 Claim boundary Candidate feature family; requires validation The bifurcation is not the event. The recovery wake is the evidence. 1. Origin example A rock in a river is not merely an object. It reshapes the surrounding field. Pressure builds before the obstacle. Flow lines split around the constraint before direct collision. Downstream, the system does not instantly return to baseline. It produces a wake, eddies, partial rejoining, and a new channel memory. 2. Definition A post-bifurcation recovery signature is a morphology or signal pattern appearing downstream of a split event, where a system that encountered resistance, obstruction, pressure, or uncertainty partially re-coheres into a new stable or semi-stable path. 3. Natural Math sequence EXTEND - the system continues forward. SENSE - pressure accumulates before a boundary. RESTRICT - direct continuation is blocked or constrained. BIFURCATE - the system splits into available channels. HOLD / turbulent wake - downstream instability while resolution is incomplete. SEMI-RECOVERY - branches partially rejoin, stabilize, or select a dominant path. MEMORY MARK - the channel is altered; the next flow is not born into a blank world. A split tells us the system encountered choice or constraint. The recovery zone tells us what the system became afterward. Fractal dimension measures complexity. MCVA must also measure recovery. 4. Cross-domain examples Rivers Pressure buildup before an obstacle, split flow, eddies, downstream wake, sediment deposition, and erosional marks. Cracks Stress buildup, asymmetric branch survival, arrested tips, secondary microcracks, and a dominant propagation path after the split. Roads Crack branching around voids, patches, or aggregate boundaries and downstream propagation along a preferred weakness line. Vascular systems Flow obstruction, collateral routing, altered vessel caliber, partial recovery, or downstream failure states. Lightning Leader branching, failed leaders, dominant channel selection, and return current through the selected path. Dendrites and growth fronts Growth splitting around a local constraint, branch competition, local depletion zones, and persistent downstream asymmetry. Forests Storm damage, recovery marks, altered crown routing, and inherited geometry after disturbance or obstruction. Cognition and signals Contradiction, pressure buildup, decision split, HOLD, narrative repair, and an altered downstream reasoning path. 5. Descriptor candidates Pre-bifurcation pressure indicators: thickening, local density increase, curvature change, narrowing, compression, crowding. Bifurcation geometry: split angle, child-branch count, asymmetry, dominant or recessive branch ratio, branch survival length. Wake / recovery zone: reconvergence, arrested tips, secondary branching, density relaxation, smoothing, loops, anisotropy shift. Memory mark: persistent widening, narrowing, altered branch spacing, dead zones, deposition traces, repeated future routing. 6. Guardrails Do not infer obstruction or recovery from a single image unless a domain baseline supports it. Prefer time-series or before-and-after imagery. Route ambiguous cases to HOLD. Route non-diagnostic cases to AMCVA. Treat this as a candidate feature family until validated. Do not make medical, structural safety, or disaster prediction claims without domain-specific validation. Natural Math MCVA / AMCVA / HOLD Tom Wessels study guide Desiloizing Geometry
